player_prompt.intro:
Owe udi Muntu {player_id} mu mafuku {num_rounds} ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kilumbu kimo, kamba nambari kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Kufwa malumbu yonso mawili, ndekele (2/3) x (mukanda wa malumbu yonso mawili),
ne Muntu udi wa kamba uye wa pene na ndekele akunda mafuku ayo.
Yamuka na kamba yako mu mfumo '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mpangilu mubi; suaku utume muudi wela meji bu [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Udi mua kuela meji ne: udi munkatshi mua {min_guess} too ne mu {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mwana 0 akamba {guess0}; Mwana 1 akamba {guess1}. Kwa hivyo Lengo ni: {target}.
message.round_win: Muena manaya {winner} ke udi upeta ditumba!

outcome.p0_wins: Muena manaya 0 uvua mupete mashinyi a bungi.
outcome.p1_wins: Muena manaya 1 uvua mupete mashinyi a bungi.
